notes.title: Minor Update 1.09
notes.content:
minor fixes:
- adjustments to the combinations allowed in match & sequence mode
- bug fix when replaying level after game over.

major fix:
- after performing a combination, clicking quickly on another piece allowed it to also be destroyed

notes.title: Version 1.03 minor fixes and features
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Timer remains paused after losing focus (alt+tab) and returning to game (return to focus)
- Bet button label error: 1:3 is correct, not 3:1
- Unlocked levels menu option fix (unlocked previous level must be the current one)

Additions:
- Button Actions: Bet, Buy moves, Sell moves and Buy Specials now pauses the timer so the player can think freely before committing to the action.
- Display showing the amount of remaining pieces
